caption_L1: Here a line chart is labeled Number of justifiable homicides by law enforcement officers and private citizens in the United States from 2007 to 2019. Private citizens is drawn using a linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 400 along the y-axis. There is a linear scale of range 2008 to 2018 on the x-axis, marked Year.
caption_L2L3: There has been an increase overall in the number of justifiable homicides by private citizens between 2008 to 2018.  The increase has not been year on year, there have been dips most noticeably in 2011 and 2014.   In 2012/13 and 2015/16 the number was stagnant.
